_note: Role -> model. Subagent frontmatter models apply whatever model the main session runs on.
claude: Claude Code aliases (haiku|sonnet|opus|fable|inherit) or full ids. Claude Code cannot run OpenAI models.
cursor: one id per profile. Switch with `bridge cursor-profile <anthropic|openai|mixed>` (rewrites ~/.cursor/agents).
anthropic = Claude models; openai = GPT-5.6 family; mixed = Claude implements, GPT reviews (cross-family review).
Cursor ids are not all documented: gpt-5.6-sol is; gpt-5.6-luna/terra and claude-haiku/sonnet-5-5 follow Cursor's naming. Confirm in Cursor's model picker.
